conditionalReadCrosswalk: Source software-mode cell and adjacent thresholds are XDATA state by their initializer/setter/consumer operations, rather than program CODE/version pointer or ACPI host-page offset.

If the selected image and XDATA mapping apply, the selected generic reader addresses that same domain and returns the current cell independently of setter echo; the operation is not a charger bus read.
The symbolic first-high/second-low address contract is separate from little-endian WMI header fields; no actual state location was split into components.
The reader replaces its first input cell with one sample; selected callback puts that sample at the already reviewed output position and returns only its bounded prefix.
A candidate mode-one sample does not prove current80/75 thresholds: initialization occurs only when a changed incoming value becomes one. No additional threshold read is added to A.
